name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '15' is the dispatch-table index (idx 0x15) of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 -- a meaningful domain ID, confirmed by the DATA xref at 0x51be5 (= 0x51b91 + 0x54 = 0x15*4) whose little-endian dword d9470300 equals this function's address 0x000347d9. 'ch6' = chapter 6 (valid chapter ID 1-30) and 'char_cond' = char-conditional category (gates on a character alive-check); both accurate to the body. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Chapter 6 turn-event slot 1 (dispatch idx 0x15, fired at turn 10 / phase 2): if char_id 8 (the ch6 elite-warrior boss NPC, named 索倫 in dialogue) is still alive, show dialog page 2; otherwise do nothing.
logic_summary: Compiler-injected __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue, then bVar = fd2_check_char_is_dead(8); if it returns 0 (char 8 alive) call fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=2, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) and clean up ESP by 0x24; RET. Single branch (the alive gate); no RNG, no numeric computation, return value of the dialog call discarded. EBX is not touched (RET has no POP EBX). In the original binary the page-2 dialog call is the head of a class-3 shared tail at 0x347F1 that fd2_chapter_event_handler_32__ch22_sara_recruit JMPs into (unconditional jump from 0x35295) for its own page-2 dialog; reproduced inline here for Layer-2 equivalence.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl dispatch argument from the per-event handler table at 0x51B91. The body never reads it ((void)event_arg).
params.reason: Descriptive of the dispatch-table calling convention; not a param_1 placeholder and carries no address residue. Matches the convention used across all sibling handlers in chevt1.c.

returns.semantics: No return value (dispatch handler; the disassembly ends in a bare RET and the discarded fd2_display_dialog_scene return is not propagated).

notes: Verified against disassembly: PUSH 0x28/CALL __CHK; PUSH 8/CALL fd2_check_char_is_dead(0x3453e)/ADD ESP,4/TEST EAX,EAX/JNZ 0x34818; 9 PUSHes (1,0x13,0x4a,0x4c,0xcd,0x140,0xa0000,page=2, then PUSH dword [0x53a79]=data_fd2_current_chapter_text)/CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene(0x15f84)/ADD ESP,0x24; RET. The decompiler's 'fixup to 00003a79' note is a Ghidra artifact -- the real operand at 0x3480a is PUSH dword ptr [0x53a79] (READ of data_fd2_current_chapter_text), confirmed via get_xrefs_from. fd2_check_char_is_dead signature byte __cdecl(uint). Source comment in chevt1.c (lines 856-889) already precise/accurate/ASCII (Chinese only for the proper name 索倫) and matches asm exactly -> comment kept, chevt1.c untouched.
